description: How the weekly AI ranking is scored. Weights sum to 100. The AI proposes 0-10 scores per dimension for each gateway; a human reviews and may override any score with a written reason (recorded in the week's history file).

tokenSaving.description: Routing to cheaper models, caching (exact + semantic), budgets/cost limits, fee/markup structure. The core lens of this ranking.

reliability.description: Fallback, retries, load balancing, tail latency, provider outage handling.

coverage.description: Model/provider catalog breadth and how fast new models land.

devEx.description: Time to first call, docs, SDK/OpenAI compatibility, local-first options.

governance.description: Guardrails, RBAC, audit logs, prompt management, compliance evidence (SOC 2/HIPAA/GDPR).

priceTransparency.description: Clear pricing, no hidden markups/fees, per-request cost metadata.

rules: Score evidence first: every score change vs last week needs a one-line reason (price change, new feature, outage, acquisition).
No sponsored placements. If a vendor relationship exists, disclose it in the history file.
A gateway that cannot be verified this week keeps last week's scores (stale, not guessed).
Human override always wins and is marked with author + reason.
